# Lab 783

> Seven Eighty Three, known as Lab 783, is an independent systems laboratory and venture foundry built from the mulch up. We apply principles of engineered nature to physical supply chains, sovereign digital environments, and organizational infrastructure.

## Thesis and framework

Lab 783 applies carrying capacity, closed-loop energy transfer, and self-regulating feedback loops to physical supply chains, sovereign digital environments, and organizational infrastructure.

The Universe API is Argelys Samuel Oriach’s dual macro–micro systems design framework, operating below the query layer to govern structural indexing and deterministic data flow. It is a design framework; the Food API is a separate food-systems specification, not a deployed API.

- [Universe API](https://argelysoriach.com/universe-api/)
- [Point Zero](https://pointzero.systems/)
- [Founder: Argelys Samuel Oriach](https://argelysoriach.com/)

## Read the laboratory

- [Home and thesis](https://seveneightythree.com/)

- [Structure](https://seveneightythree.com/structure/): Lab 783 is the foundry. Wild-Lake is its research laboratory. Communal Foundation is its first company.
- [Research prospectus](https://seveneightythree.com/prospectus/): Proposed field work, documentation, and prototype development for the 2026 pre-seed round; proposed outputs are not completed deliverables.

## Laboratories and ventures

- [Wild-Lake](https://wild-lake.org/): Wild Lake Studio, the research laboratory of Lab 783, is a brutalist talent architecture and structural design studio. Not for sale. Artist development, A&R, and creative infrastructure on a retainer or fixed project fee; no ownership or percentage of an artist’s work. Artist participation is willing, directly or through a representative.
- [Communal Foundation / Food API specification](https://seveneightythree.com/ventures/food-api/): Communal Foundation is a food-systems venture built around the Food API specification. It exists as a specification and has not been deployed. It is available for acquisition and development. Chef-driven artistry under hyper-local constraints. Part of what the venture earns returns to the communities it serves. The commitment scales with earnings and transfers with the venture to any acquirer.
- [Venture site](https://communalfoundation.org/)

## Intake protocol

- [Intake](https://seveneightythree.com/intake/): Three required fields: name, system objective, and current architecture. Drafts an email in the visitor’s email app; nothing is sent until the visitor sends it. No backend submission or automatic email.
- [Acquisition inquiry](https://seveneightythree.com/intake/?interest=food-api): Prefills the objective for the Food API specification.
- Public inquiries: hello@seveneightythree.com. Location: New York / Worldwide.
